title: Eventual compatibility of a fixed family of local lifts
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} S$, and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$, finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $F_j,G_j$ on $X_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and a map $\varphi:(F_j)_X\to(G_j)_X$. Write X_t for the base change of X_i to Spec R_t. At a stage k ≥ j, let A_0 and B_0 be tensor pullback from X_j to X_k and from X_k to X, and e_0 their canonical comparison with direct pullback [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Suppose a finite affine cover U_0 at stage k and a family r_0 of local maps are given, whose pullbacks recover phi through the canonical composition and restriction comparisons. For l ≥ k let q:X_l→X_k be the transition, A tensor pullback from X_j to X_l, B tensor pullback from X_l to X, e the canonical comparison with direct pullback, and z:A≅A_0 followed by tensor pullback along q the canonical composition comparison. There is a later stage l where the explicit conjugated pullback of r_0 on the pullback cover U is the component family of a descent-data morphism psi. The pulled-back cover is affine, and the same explicit family still recovers phi. The pullback family is defined using the canonical composition comparison z and the restriction comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]; no new component maps are chosen.

proof.text:
For each pair of members of U₀, cover their intersection by finitely many
affine opens. Quasi-separatedness makes each intersection quasi-compact. On each
such affine the difference of the two pullbacks of r₀ becomes zero on the limit:
the recovery equations identify both with the restriction of the same map phi,
and ordinary pullback composition respects these restrictions. Apply the equality
clause of finitePresentation_descent_directedColimit on the affine overlap ring
system. There are finitely many charts and pairs, so directedness gives one later
stage where every difference is zero. This equality is preserved by further base
change. On that stage the overlap cover is still a cover; sheaf morphism locality
makes the two restrictions agree on the full intersection. Any test scheme mapping
to two cover members factors through their intersection, so further pullback gives
the descent compatibility equation. Assemble the family as a descent-data
morphism whose components are exactly r. The family r is the explicit conjugated pullback of
r₀, not a new choice of maps. Composition of the canonical tensor comparisons and
ordinary pullback composition transports the original recovery equations to the
last equation. The pulled-back cover remains finite and affine because the stage
transition is affine. Empty intersections impose no equations; the empty family
and zero modules use k itself. Noetherianity is unnecessary.
